rule_or_requirement: A faster pixel-only actor must retain valid finish-line crossings under risk; mechanism activation must precede fresh score comparison.

allowed_action_or_state_change: Four independent observation-action wrappers may suppress gas, apply mild brake, or adjust steering locally around the fixed stable-risk actor; checkpoint and environment remain unchanged.
expected_success_endpoint: At least one direction visibly changes actions on consumed TRAIN cells without losing a control-completed cell, then qualifies for separately registered fresh tune comparison.
control: Frozen stable-risk envelope over selected full-road-guard checkpoint SHA-256 3ceb5ebbe2a4bd96944649a693b8ef924c0252fa620b0fd547c7fb494afff199.
falsifier: Zero action changes or candidate-only retirement on a control-completed TRAIN cell; any input beyond the four grayscale observations invalidates the direction.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Five arms on consumed TRAIN 1:43 and 2:102 with 2,000 decision limit and full action traces.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU benchmark of ten episodes, at most 1,800 seconds; no fresh tune or official cell access in this run.
